title: Close the physical bridge at the actual staged controller
statement: The exact coherent 12D live-tag walk has G-S*(G)=I, G<16I and initial M=+ lifetime<15. Initial collision <=3/r and the causal incoming live-label hazard 3/r give p_bad<=min(1,48/r) uniformly in every finite horizon. In the adversarial ensemble each hidden Pauli P_j is drawn ONCE and reused whenever j returns; before a live collision, losing the target erases all reference correlations and a surviving sole unknown Pauli twirls them. Any final known receiver therefore has E_P Fe<=min(1,1/4+36/r), implying worst-U half-diamond error>=max(0,3/4-36/r). In the stated normalized ellipse, 2G gives initial lifetime<30, uniform<32, p_bad<=min(1,93/r) and E_P Fe<=min(1,1/4+279/(4r)).
